north.source: The model flyers' spot at threshold 29 of the Kamnik airstrip (LZS operating manual 2021: model aircraft use the first 50 m from threshold 29): 25 m in from the threshold along the runway and 18 m north of its centreline, on open grass between the runway and the hangars in the GURS GKOT 2023-25 photo; D96/TM E 467840, N 117512 (research/kamnik/README.md).

radius.source: HELI-20a conservative radial envelope around the loaded main and tail discs and four skids; estimated model geometry, not a measured safety radius.

max_takeoff_tilt.source: HELI-20a layout envelope for initial lift-off; spherical reach is orientation-independent and the value is not a qualified flight limit.

rotorcraft_pad.provenance: Kamnik field layout: the pad stands on the grass 12 m north of the pilot, away from the runway, nose east. Footprint, aircraft envelope, clearance margin and keepouts are the default field's simulator estimates, not measured geometry or RC safety standards. The rotorpad is a zero-relief support patch on the surveyed terrain.
